slices.focus: Lotte Giants event sparks genuine interest in baseball and interviews.
slices.summary: Min-seo gets tickets to a Lotte Giants offseason fan event from a dental patient. Jae-hyun unexpectedly becomes invested, following winter roster news, player interviews, and training routines. He and Min-seo share a low-pressure hobby that fits his schedule (clips and interviews rather than live games) and adds a light, shared topic to their marriage.
open_loops: Building a reliable source list for team news
decisions: Jae-hyun's sports preference sharpened from casual Lotte Giants followership to actively checking offseason roster news
